text:
Mats Zuccarello is 39, in his first season with Los Angeles, and he hasn't played since October 24. ESPN has now cleared him from its injury report, so he could be back as soon as tonight against Nashville.

The six games he did play were hard to watch: one assist, and the Kings had only 31% of the five-on-five expected goals (the quality of chances) with him on the ice. Don't read much into six games, especially at the start of a new team and before an injury. The talent says something different. He had 54 points in 59 games for Minnesota last season, and Evolving-Hockey had him 73rd among 401 forwards in wins above replacement.

He's an undrafted Norwegian who came over from Modo in Sweden and built a career of more than 960 games as a playmaker. Our projection still expects about 49 points from here, which assumes he's the passer he was last year. The first few games back will tell us whether that's fair.
